system.description: The ability to jury-rig, bodge, and make do. Improvise covers rapid, temporary solutions constructed from whatever is available - hotwiring a vehicle, fashioning a crude weapon, rigging a door shut, building a basic trap, or fashioning a disguise from bin bags and gaffer tape. The results work, for now, under these conditions. They are not elegant and they will not last. For considered, reliable construction, see Craft.
system.overcome: Use Improvise to build a functional temporary solution to an immediate problem using available materials, carry out a rapid repair that will hold under pressure for a limited time, or turn an unpromising object into something useful right now.
system.caa: Use Improvise to establish a situational aspect - Crude Barricade, Makeshift Firestarter, Trip-Wire Rigged Across the Doorway - that provides a meaningful tactical or practical advantage in the current scene.
system.attack: An improvised weapon - a broken chair leg, a length of pipe, a sharpened stake - can be used to attack. When using Improvise to attack with a weapon you have just constructed, the attack uses Improvise rather than Physique.
system.defend: Providing the scene supports the intention, you can Defend yourself by using a human shield or pulling a makeshift shield in front of you, or the classic cutting of the right rope to be whisked away to safety by a convenient pulley system. You get this just once.
